title: 《童年》
hint: 64拍主歌练习段，非全曲；仅校正开头两处同音延音，81个单音，其余音符与版本差异待核。105 BPM 沿用练习设定；旧伴奏暂不使用。

unsupported: 主旋律版只保留从“池塘边”到“等待游戏的童年”的练习段；全谱后续歌词多为同旋律反复。
和弦、双手钢琴伴奏与吉他指弹织体移入和弦版或作为来源复核，不写入 V1 steps。
本次只合并开头G4[2,3.5)与A4[5.5,6.5)的同音延音，其余79个音符元组不变；不是完整开头或整段64拍校准。
第9–10拍C5是否另起音、第15–16拍是否休止存在来源版本分歧，均保留旧值；后续音区、节奏、反复及结尾仍待核。
105 BPM和默认0.9倍速为沿用练习设定；吉他世界公开谱标示四分音符=120，不将练习设定冒充来源速度。
旧V2保留原83音与原伴奏，和修正后的单音旋律不兼容，不借用其自动伴奏。
unsureMeasures: App [9,10): GuitarWorld ties the two C5 eighths, while HGNU writes separate attacks; retain legacy C5@9/1.
App [15,16): GuitarWorld writes a quarter rest, while HGNU holds G4; retain legacy G4@12/4.
Outside the two adopted tie spans, the 64-beat excerpt has not been source-calibrated; later rhythm, register, form and ending remain pending.

currentScopeReview.decision: Adopt only the two same-pitch ties common to the recorded GuitarWorld public preview and the independent HGNU teaching edition. Do not select either edition for the conflicting next two bars or replace the full excerpt.

tieCorrections.sourceDegrees: Undotted 5 quarter tied to undotted 5 eighth; one attack, 1 + 0.5 beats.
Undotted 6 eighth tied to undotted 6 eighth; one attack, 0.5 + 0.5 beats.

sourceEditions.edition: 吉他老杨编，罗大佑词曲唱，C调指弹谱；仅公开预览。
sourceEditions.mapping: Source absolute quarter beat minus 16 = app beat: omit instrumental measures 1–4; adopt only the two ties in printed measures 5–6 of the lyric-aligned numbered melody, not guitar tab or highest chord tones.
sourceEditions.accessLimit: Only four vocal bars are visible in the public preview. The full two-page score requires login/purchase and was not accessed; repeat ending and full-song form were not reviewed.

sourceEditions.edition: 童年／民谣吉他曲／罗大佑词曲；教材印刷第42–43页。
sourceEditions.mapping: First vocal bar starts at app beat 0. Uniform G-to-C normalization (-7 semitones) retains every octave dot for comparison only; production adopts no transposition or octave folding.
sourceEditions.independenceLimit: Separately published teaching arrangement, not the missing Qupu original. Agreement supports the two ties only; differing later articulation, rest, register and form are not spliced into the legacy melody.

currentScopeReview.notationDecision: Both sources show identical pitch and octave-dot state at each tie endpoint. G4 spans 2–3.5 and A4 spans 5.5–6.5 with no second attack. E4@3.5 and A4@6.5 are separate following attacks; different-pitch slurs and adjacent untied repeated notes retain their attacks.

excludedEditionConflicts.guitarworld: Two upper-1 eighths tied as one C5@9/1.
excludedEditionConflicts.hgnu: Two upper-1 eighths separately attacked at 9 and 9.5.

excludedEditionConflicts.guitarworld: G4@12 lasts 3 beats, followed by one quarter rest [15,16).
excludedEditionConflicts.hgnu: G4@12 lasts 4 beats with no final quarter rest.
excludedEditionConflicts.decision: Unresolved edition choice; no change or new silence claim.

currentScopeReview.encodedExtentMeaning: Retained legacy event end only, not a newly verified source ending, final-rest decision or complete-song extent. No sourceTotalBeats claim is added.
currentScopeReview.retainedPracticeTempo: 105 BPM remains the historical practice setting; GuitarWorld prints quarter=120 and HGNU prints no tempo on these pages. The 0.9 default suggests 94.5 BPM, not the actual selected or remembered runtime multiplier. No silent tempo normalization.
currentScopeReview.sourceForm: Retain the existing one-strophe practice extent and hasRepeats classification as historical metadata. Omit instrumental material and later lyric strophes as before; no newly approved repeat expansion or full-song form.
currentScopeReview.originalSourceLimits: Six historical image paths are absent. Qupu was not reverified following a reported certificate problem; Sohu returned HTTP 403 and was not bypassed. Older hint and metadata are historical claims, not current proof.

accompanimentReview.decision: Leave the V2 file byte-identical. Its melody still matches the legacy 83 tuples; content compatibility must reject automatic/practice backing reuse for the corrected V1. Historical rhythm.sourceStatus=verified is not new harmony or whole-song approval.

currentScopeReview.limitations: Only G4[2,3.5) and A4[5.5,6.5) are adopted source decisions. No complete opening, 64-beat excerpt, later octave/rhythm, harmony, form or source-ending approval. Browser scheduling/audio, reference listening and physical play-through remain separate pending checks. Public access does not establish public-distribution rights; raw source images and the complete comparison fixture stay outside the repository.
